public_footer: This page shows what {name} has chosen to publish. Their discussions, drafts and internal records are not here.
public_subtitle: Governance, published by the community itself
public_provisional: Rules adopted before this community had agreed how it makes decisions: {count}
public_nothing_published: This community has not published any of its governance documents yet.
public_not_decided: Not yet decided by this community.
public_local_note: Rules this community wrote for itself, which {standard} does not ask for.
public_about_body: This community governs itself against {standard} v{version}, an open standard for community governance. What appears here is what they chose to publish; their discussions, drafts and member records are private to them.
publishing_nothing_publishable: Nothing yet — an artifact becomes publishable once you have adopted at least one of its sections.
publishing_activity: What has been published, and when
publishing_no_activity: Nothing has been published or withdrawn yet.
language_heading: The language this community works in
language_intro: One language for everybody here. Governance is a shared activity, and two members reading the same rule in two languages is how a disagreement becomes an argument about translation.
language_unchanged: This changes what the interface and the standard are shown in. It changes nothing the community wrote — every definition, decision and rationale stays in the words it was written in.
language_saved: Saved. Every member sees this community in the new language.
language_steward_only: Only a steward can change this.
account_erase_what_goes: Your name, your email address and anything you set about yourself are deleted, along with every way of signing in. This cannot be undone.
account_erase_what_stays: What your communities decided stays. Decisions name a membership rather than a person, so your part of the record continues to read as a former member — which is why the count of who was present is still true afterwards.
account_erase_your_labels: In your communities you will read as:
account_erase_owner_warning: You own a community. Transfer ownership to another member first — a community with no owner cannot be governed or closed.
legal_draft_notice: Draft — this has not been reviewed by counsel. It describes what the software does, which is not the same as being legally sufficient.
footer_licence: RCOS Compass is licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.
feedback_heading: Report a problem with this screen
feedback_privacy: We record which screen you were on and what you type here. Nothing else from the page is sent.
feedback_sent: Thank you. A steward can see this too.
members_intro: Everyone in this community, with the number their membership carries in your own records. The number is what your decisions refer to, so it stays even when the person does not.
members_owner_note: Transfer ownership before changing this member’s role or ending their membership.
members_steward_only: Only a steward can change a role or end a membership.
members_ended: That membership has ended. The record stays; the access does not.
members_former_intro: Memberships that have ended. They are shown rather than dropped: the decisions these people consented to still count them, and a list that quietly lost them would disagree with your own register.
members_you_note: Ask another steward to change your role or end your membership. Authority you take away from yourself is not authority you can give back.
invitation_role_steward: As a steward you will be able to publish drafts, run decisions, and manage who is here.
invitation_role_member: As a member you will be able to take part in discussions, propose changes, and consent to decisions.
invitation_owner: You will hold this community's owner flag.
invitation_wrong_address: This invitation was sent to {invited}, and you are signed in as {current}.
invitation_wrong_address_help: An invitation only works for the address it was sent to. Sign out and sign in with that address, or ask for a new invitation for the one you use.
invitation_expired_body: An invitation is good for {days} days. Ask {community} to send a new one.
invitation_used_heading: This invitation has already been used
invitation_used_body: If that was you, sign in with the address it was sent to.
invitation_unknown_body: It may have been mistyped, withdrawn, or replaced by a newer invitation. Ask whoever invited you to send another.
invitation_create_body: Your account will use {email} — the address this invitation was sent to.
invitation_name_hint: What the community will see next to what you write.
invitation_password_hint: At least {min} characters. Length helps more than punctuation does.
invitation_have_account: Already have an account for this address?
invitation_error_name: Enter the name the community will see.
invitation_error_exists: There is already an account for this address. Sign in, then open this link again.
invitation_error_failed: That did not work. Try again.
invitation_sign_in_body: Sign in with {email} — the address this invitation was sent to — and it will be waiting.
dashboard_next_subtitle: The questions worth answering before anything else · ordered by the Path rules
artifacts_intro: An artifact is complete when every section it asks for has an adopted definition. Nothing here is a percentage of compliance — it is a count of work.
artifacts_compliance_note: Compliance is binary. Until every required artifact exists, what {community} says outwardly stays “not yet compliant” — there is no percentage that changes that.
artifacts_none: This community has not adopted a standard yet, so there is nothing to complete.
about_intro: What this tool is licensed under, and what the standard it carries is licensed under. The documents your community agreed to are linked at the bottom of every screen and here.
about_standard_none: This community has not adopted a standard yet.
path_release: Put it back where the ordering had it
path_draft_heading: You moved {count} — only you can see this order.
path_draft_steward: Publish it and every member sees it on their dashboard.
path_draft_member: A steward publishes an order for everybody. Yours stays yours until one does.
path_published: Published. Every member sees this order now.
path_unpin: Take the community's placement off this one
path_placed_by_community: The community placed this here. The ordering puts it at {position}.
path_presets_help: Each of these changes the strengths on “How the path is ordered”. All three keep the structural order intact — they change what pulls within it.
path_preset_applied: Order updated. “How the path is ordered” shows what changed.
linter_not_run_title: The linter has not run on this text
linter_not_run_stale: The text changed since the linter last ran
linter_not_run_why: It splits the text into lines and judges each one against its own job. Until it runs there is nothing to split by, so the annotated view stays unavailable.
linter_not_run_after: Once it has run, the result stays attached to this version — re-running is explicit, never automatic on read.
draft_plain_hint: — optional, and what most people will actually read
draft_section_why: Saved for the community to see, and binding on nobody. It becomes an answer when a proposal carrying it is frozen.
documents_upload_notice: Every member of {community} will be able to read these files. Nothing is published outside the community.
library_description: Everything {community} has already written down. Upload a document, start a scan, and Compass suggests which RCOS clause each passage answers. You confirm or reject every suggestion.
library_drop_heading: Drop PDFs, Word files or plain text here
library_drop_examples: Bylaws, meeting minutes, handbooks, land agreements.
library_drop_limits: Up to {files} files, {mb} MB each ({mb} MB in total without JavaScript).
library_coverage: {have} of {of} requirements already have language somewhere in them
library_footer: Compass never changes a document. Mapping only proposes where its language could satisfy a clause.
library_empty: Nothing yet. If your community has written agreements, bylaws or minutes, this is the shortest way in — you are probably further along than the dashboard says.
library_progress_not_governance: Nothing in it answers a requirement
library_remove_warning: Removing {filename} makes {claims} confirmed claims stale and deletes {versions} earlier versions. The files are gone for good.
library_upload_too_many: Upload at most {files} files at once.
library_scan_already: A scan of {filename} is already running.
workspace_coverage: You already have language for {have} of {of} requirements.
workspace_ai_note: ✦ AI-drafted · nothing is applied until you confirm
workspace_no_cards: Nothing in this document is mapped to a clause yet.
workspace_by_hand_hint: You can also map a paragraph by hand: select it in the document.
workspace_scan_queued: Compass is scanning this document. Suggestions appear as it reads.
workspace_scan_already: A scan of this document is already running.
workspace_hand_whole: Select words in the paragraph to map just those; otherwise the whole paragraph is mapped.
workspace_clause_hint: A reference like 3.6.2, or words from the requirement.
workspace_reconfirm_intro: These paragraphs say exactly what a confirmed claim said before the file changed. Put each claim back if it still holds.
workspace_on_page: Identified on this page: {count} · Pages with governance language: {pages}
workspace_all_answered: Every identified passage has an answer.
workspace_reading: Compass is still reading this document. Its text appears here when it is done.
workspace_no_text: There are no readable passages in this document.
queue_not_adopt: Confirming does not adopt this language. It records that your documents already speak to this ref.
queue_hand_hint: To map a paragraph by hand, open the document and select the paragraph.
original_failed: This PDF couldn’t be shown as it was uploaded. Here is its text; you can download the original.
original_truncated: This PDF is longer than the viewer lays out, so only its first {count} pages are shown here. The text view and the download have all of it.
account_time_zone_intro: Times are shown to you in this zone, and notification digests arrive on its mornings.
account_time_zone_none: Not set — times follow each community's own zone
time_zone_intro: The community's calendar: review dates fall on its days, and members who have not set their own time zone see times in it. Nothing already recorded changes.
time_zone_saved: Saved. Calendar dates now follow this time zone.
notification_consent_opened: A proposal in “{title}” is waiting for your response
notification_export_ready: Your export is ready to download
notification_scan_complete_one: Scan of {filename} finished: 1 passage to review
notification_scan_complete_many: Scan of {filename} finished: {count} passages to review
notification_quiet: “{title}”, which you opened, has been quiet for two weeks
notification_role_steward: You are now a steward of this community
notification_role_member: You are now a member of this community, no longer a steward
notification_claim_withdrawn: This community no longer meets every mandatory requirement, so its compliance claim is withdrawn
notifications_intro: What happened in this community that concerns you. Opening one marks it read.
notifications_empty: Nothing yet. When something here concerns you — a proposal in a thread you are in, a round waiting for your response — it shows up here.
notifications_gone: What that notification was about is no longer available to you.
mention_hint: Mention a member with @ and their number, like @M-0142.
mail_consent_opened_subject: A consent round is open in {community}
mail_consent_opened_body: A proposal in {community} is waiting for your response.
mail_consent_closing_subject: A consent round closes soon in {community}
mail_consent_closing_body: A proposal in {community} you have not responded to closes {when}.
mail_role_steward_subject: You are now a steward of {community}
mail_role_steward_body: Your role in {community} is now steward.
mail_role_member_body: Your role in {community} is now member.
mail_claim_withdrawn_subject: {community} can no longer claim RCOS compliance
mail_claim_withdrawn_body: A change in {community} means its public claim of RCOS compliance was withdrawn. Compass shows what needs attention.
mail_removal_body: Your membership of {community} on RCOS Compass has ended.
mail_preferences: Choose which emails you get from {community}:
